request.query: The complement of a finite set is eventually true in the cofinite filter; finite exceptions to rational approximation lower bound

items.name: Filter.eventually_cofinite
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} {p : α → Prop}, (∀ᶠ (x : α) in Filter.cofinite, p x) ↔ {x | ¬p x}.Finite

items.name: Filter.mem_cofinite
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} {s : Set α}, s ∈ Filter.cofinite ↔ sᶜ.Finite

items.name: Set.Finite.compl_mem_cofinite
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} {s : Set α}, s.Finite → sᶜ ∈ Filter.cofinite

items.name: Finset.eventually_cofinite_notMem
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} (s : Finset α), ∀ᶠ (x : α) in Filter.cofinite, x ∉ s

items.name: Set.Finite.eventually_cofinite_notMem
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} {s : Set α}, s.Finite → ∀ᶠ (x : α) in Filter.cofinite, x ∉ s

items.name: Filter.hasBasis_cofinite
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2}, Filter.cofinite.HasBasis (fun s => s.Finite) compl

items.name: Filter.compl_mem_hyperfilter_of_finite
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Infinite α] {s : Set α}, s.Finite → sᶜ ∈ Filter.hyperfilter α

items.name: Filter.mem_hyperfilter_of_finite_compl
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Infinite α] {s : Set α}, sᶜ.Finite → s ∈ Filter.hyperfilter α
